svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given a screen with several test cases, each keeping its own record; beat 1: a run covers only one case → that case's record updates and every other case keeps its own steps and log — folded, never replaced; beat 2: a case has run several times → it keeps its last ten runs, each headed by time, duration and the commit it ran against — the commit on its meta line; beat 3: a run matched no test → it is recorded as an error saying no tests ran — never "0 of 0 passing"
